result:
Summary: The U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Core CPI are scheduled to be released this week on October 14, 2026, at 12:30 PM ET. The CPI for September 2026 was released on September 11, 2026, at 12:30 PM ET, and the core CPI for September 2026 is forecasted to be 2.5% year-over-year. The CPI for August 2026 was released on August 12, 2026, at 12:30 PM ET, showing a 2.4% year-over-year increase. The next CPI release is scheduled for November 10, 2026, at 08:30 AM ET.
